title: Kovbasa Domashnia
description: Ready-made sausage from the catalog is roasted with garlic; fresh sausage production requires casing ingredients not currently included.

steps.instruction: Pierce the prepared Ukrainian homemade sausage in several places, then rub with crushed garlic and pepper. This version uses ready-made sausage from the ingredient catalog.
Roast in a 190°C oven until browned and heated thoroughly; turn once so the casing colors evenly.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
